correctness.rationale: The explicit max-minus-second-max PL simplex retraction is continuous across ties, equivariant, fixes each vertex and star, and glues across exactly singleton row-column intersections. Its image is the incidence graph subdividing K_m,n; no group edge reverses endpoint types. Therefore all quotient and fixed-space claims reduce to exact graph actions. Rectangular integral cycles form a unimodular basis of U_m tensor U_n and coordinate interchange reverses oriented edges, validating the minus flip. Small-case independent boundary and quotient calculations and exact rational symmetry checks corroborate every ingredient but are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Uniform arbitrary-subgroup quotient homotopy types and free fundamental groups are natural invariants of a high-dimensional graph independence complex; they are not determined by the old ordinary circle count. The diagonal transitive case links quotient topology exactly to permutation-group orbitals (rank r(H)-1); balanced coordinate interchange produces binomial(n-1,2) circles while its fixed locus has n components. Complete integral symmetry operators add meaningful information beyond ordinary Betti numbers. This is a natural complete classification over all dimensions and symmetries, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
